title: decrypt.rs: CEK Vec not zeroed after content decryption
description:
In decrypt(), the cek returned by both key.decrypt_cek() (KTRI path, line 105) and key.agree_ecdh() (KARI path, line 226-231) is a plain Vec<u8> bound at line 59. It is passed into decrypt_aes128_cbc / decrypt_aes256_cbc and then dropped without zeroing. The plaintext CEK remains accessible in heap memory until the allocator reuses or zeroes that region.

Fix: wrap the cek binding in Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> in find_and_decrypt_cek() and propagate the type through to the CBC decrypt functions (which take &[u8] so no signature change needed — only the owning binding changes).

Acceptance: cek is Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> in find_and_decrypt_cek and decrypt(), and the CBC helper functions still accept &[u8] slices.
